description: Annual Enplanements in NYS Airports: Beginning 1997 is a dataset listed in State of New York open data portal (data.ny.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of New York. The dataset lists the number of passengers boarding an aircraft at the NYS Airports. Coverage: New York State. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are air passengers, enplanements, airports. The table has 4 columns. Attribution on the portal: New York State Department of Transportation. The portal shows 2026-04-03 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-ny-gov-portal.
